# provenance for today
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
DT="2026-10-28"
tz=timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
paths=[
 os.path.expanduser("~/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl"),
 os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"),
 os.path.expanduser("~/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl"),
]
for p in paths:
  print("===", p, "exists=", os.path.exists(p))
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    continue
  n=0
  with open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
    for line in f:
      line=line.strip()
      if not line: continue
      try:
        o=json.loads(line)
      except Exception:
        continue
      # try find date fields
      blob=json.dumps(o, ensure_ascii=False)
      if DT not in blob and "2026-10-28" not in blob:
        # also check ts
        ts=o.get("ts") or o.get("timestamp") or o.get("created_at") or o.get("time") or ""
        if DT not in str(ts):
          continue
      src=o.get("source") or o.get("from") or o.get("kind") or ""
      text=(o.get("text") or o.get("summary") or o.get("prompt") or o.get("content") or o.get("message") or "")
      if isinstance(text, dict):
        text=json.dumps(text, ensure_ascii=False)
      text=str(text).replace("\n"," ")[:180]
      bus=o.get("bus_id") or o.get("id") or o.get("reply_to") or ""
      print(f"- bus={bus} src={src} :: {text}")
      n+=1
      if n>=40: break
  print("shown", n)
PY
